title: LDAP search filter built by concatenating or interpolating an unescaped value
remediation:
Escape every filter metacharacter in the value on the expression that builds
the filter, using the library's own helper (python-ldap's filter_format or
escape_filter_chars, Spring's LdapEncoder.filterEncode, ESAPI's encodeForLDAP), and keep
the filter itself a fixed template. An unescaped parenthesis or asterisk lets the
supplied value close the current assertion and add one of its own, turning a lookup for
one account into a match for every account.
